# Permission evidence

Credit: Kijai and Cause — made for OptiC.

The supplied Discord post by OptiC dated 26 August 2026 states that the shader is free to use in world builds.

On 16 September 2026, the submitting maintainer explicitly confirmed permission to redistribute the supplied shader through Community Plugins. This records the supplied permission; no MIT or other standard licence is asserted, and no broader rights are implied.
